title: Protein Extraction for Amyloid Beta Fractionation
author: Lisa Blackmer-Raynolds
materials: 1x Homogenization Buffer (dilute day of): Dilute 5x Homogenization buffer to 1x in MiliQ Water and add 1 tablet protease inhibitor (cat#11697498001 Roche) per 10 mL

steps.title: Prepare 5x Homogenization Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare a 5x Homogenization Buffer and store at 4°C for up to 6 months.

substeps.instruction: Combine 125 ml of 1.0 M Tris, 30 ml of 0.5 M MgCl2, 25 ml of 0.1 M EDTA, and 20 ml of MiliQ Water.

steps.title: Prepare 1x Homogenization Buffer with 1% Triton X
steps.instruction: Prepare 1x Homogenization buffer with Triton X-100 on the day of use.

substeps.instruction: Add 1% Triton X-100 to the 1x Homogenization buffer.

steps.title: Prepare 70% Formic Acid
steps.instruction: Prepare 70% Formic Acid and store at room temperature (RT).

substeps.instruction: Mix 7 mL formic acid with 3 mL water.

steps.title: Prepare 1.5x Homogenization Buffer pH 14
steps.instruction: Prepare a corrosive 1.5x Homogenization Buffer and store at 4°C.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 5x Homogenization buffer to 1.5x in MiliQ Water.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Sample
steps.instruction: Weigh the frozen tissue sample and record the weight for later normalization.

steps.title: Extract Tris Soluble Fraction
steps.instruction: Extract the tris soluble fraction from the tissue.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue on ice using quick bursts of a sonicator in 400 µl 1x Homogenization buffer.
Centrifuge at maximum speed at 4°C for 1 hr.
Collect the supernatant as the tris soluble fraction and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Extract Triton Soluble Fraction
steps.instruction: Extract the triton soluble fraction from the remaining pellet.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize the pellet on ice using quick bursts of a sonicator in 200 µl 1x Homogenization Buffer with 1% Triton X-100.
Centrifuge at maximum speed at 4°C for 1 hr.
Collect the supernatant as the triton soluble fraction and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Extract Formic Acid Soluble Fraction
steps.instruction: Extract and neutralize the formic acid soluble fraction from the remaining pellet.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize the pellet on ice using quick bursts of a sonicator in 50 µl 70% formic acid.
Centrifuge at maximum speed at 4°C for 1 hr.
Collect the supernatant as the formic acid soluble fraction.
Neutralize the supernatant with 1.5x Homogenization buffer pH 14 on ice.
